name: Realizable Ample Classes Are Strictly Both-Sides Dismantlable
scope: Finite binary classes under the minor-atlas displayed-coordinate conventions.
statement: Realizable ample classes and their cube complements admit corner peelings; the nonrealizable peripheral class $E_{26}$ witnesses strictness.
proof: Realizable ample classes and their cube complements admit corner peelings; the nonrealizable peripheral class $E_{26}$ witnesses strictness.
